mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies near Verona Area High School with temperatures at 59 degrees, though keep in mind the air quality index is currently at a moderate 52.

In city news, the Verona Common Council recently voted to adopt the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, which sets the stage for our upcoming growth. Additionally, the city has been busy with infrastructure updates and continues to maintain a strong Moody's Aa1 rating.

We have a busy couple of days ahead! Enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Lou-ee today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Looking ahead, you can also join the fun at Hop Haus Trivia this coming Monday.

In our weekly look at police activity, on September 28, officers responded to a collision involving a motorcycle on Enterprise Drive. The driver was cited for several violations including reckless driving.
If you are looking for a treat, today's flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so stop by and enjoy a scoop later this morning.
